project.title: wastewater metagenome Raw sequence reads
project.description: This BioProject contains 16S rRNA gene amplicon sequencing data from 10 independent effluent samples collected in March 2024 in Weifang, Shandong Province, China. The samples comprised three regional aquaculture-effluent discharge sites and seven wastewater treatment plant final-effluent or discharge sites. The study aimed to compare bacterial community diversity and composition between the two effluent types and to evaluate taxonomically inferred ecological functions and predicted antibiotic resistance-related functional profiles.
project.center_name: Chinese Research Academy of Environmental Sciences
